digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate model escalation and sizing
propositions: When a primary model is not found in MODEL_LADDER, models_at_or_above returns the entire ladder instead of the primary itself, causing escalation to downgrade to claude-haiku-4-5 and cross provider families
largest_window_tokens returns MODEL_LADDER[-1][1] for unlocated primaries instead of the ladder minimum, overstating available context and causing under-blocking at P8 size budget
Both the Pass-1 escalation loop and prerequisite-coverage escalation path exhibit the same defect through different code paths, causing model downgrades and silent family crossing

The fix changes models_at_or_above to return [model] for truthy-but-unlocated primaries and largest_window_tokens to return ladder minimum, preserving single-criterion retry while stopping at operator's model
Prerequisite escalation inherits the fix without modification via existing IndexError handler that converts unlocated one-element ladder into explicit input-too-large indeterminate record
